doc:
The failure that object checks cannot catch: `.git/index.lock` exists (a crashed git, another git running),
        so `git reset --hard` fails after every object was verified. The checkpoint is whole. The person must be told,
        and must still have exactly what they had — on #419 at 0bceb0df by the tree being put back.

restore_report.detail: rewind: transcript cut, files not restored: git reset --hard b2d2cd5212b808b37dea960bdfec3b797814419c failed; and the tree could not be put back — recover by hand: git reset --hard 150d877702f426c937d6c0a92f9963de6b12c753 && git read-tree -u --reset 629cab79c03569d34ab058de8c71ef562e383c7e && git reset -q
